visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain views. Buff pointed dome/short drum, tall blind-niche church walls, open tiled roof belfry with smaller column lantern/cone, freestanding double-stage open belfry with sparse pale rails, western clock gateway, northwest pedimented pavilion and four mapped surrounding ranges are present. The low southern range has shallow vaulted roofs. Courtyard paving leaves the mapped garden open. Corrected the roof-belfry footing gap and church-door threshold, removed windows hidden on shared walls, lowered/vaulted the south range and brought skyline geometry inside its budget. Pavilion rosettes, inscription bands and tile edges are abstract fields; exact text/sculpture is excluded.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final Earth-lighting views: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, silhouette, six details, four matched whole-model levels and four transitions. Skyline keeps the dome, three towers, two main pointed belfry stages, open gateway/courtyard and mapped range masses. It uses four-post rectangular upper-stage voids, a flat south roof and paving that may continue invisibly under roofed buildings; the garden stays open. District adds shared graphs, flat window/closed-door fields, tile/clock/pavilion rhythms, eight-post upper stages and coarse south vaults. Street opens real church/door/pavilion/range recesses and adds sparse rails. Closeup/master refine dome/cone facets, clock marks, window bars, vault profiles and rail cadence. Curvature, aperture, ornament and far south-roof changes remain visible. Matched cameras show the complex; details crop intentionally. Mexican-patio neighbors are synthetic context, not local map buildings.
